question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.
sql:
WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id,
    b.over_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id
),
max_runs_overs AS (
  SELECT match_id, over_id, total_runs
  FROM over_runs
  WHERE total_runs = (SELECT MAX(total_runs) FROM over_runs o2 WHERE o2.match_id = over_runs.match_id)
),
bowler_runs_per_over AS (
  SELECT 
    b.match_id,
    b.over_id,
    b.bowler,
    SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) as bowler_runs
  FROM ball_by_ball b
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
  LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
  WHERE b.bowler IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.bowler
),
bowler_in_max_overs AS (
  SELECT bmo.match_id, bmo.over_id, bmo.bowler, bmo.bowler_runs
  FROM max_runs_overs mro
  JOIN bowler_runs_per_over bmo ON mro.match_id = bmo.match_id AND mro.over_id = bmo.over_id
),
bowler_max_runs AS (
  SELECT bowler, MAX(bowler_runs) as max_runs
  FROM bowler_in_max_overs
  GROUP BY bowler
),
top3_bowlers AS (
  SELECT bowler, max_runs
  FROM bowler_max_runs
  ORDER BY max_runs DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  bm.bowler,
  p.player_name,
  m.match_id,
  m.match_date,
  bm.max_runs
FROM top3_bowlers bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
JOIN bowler_in_max_overs bim ON bm.bowler = bim.bowler AND bm.max_runs = bim.bowler_runs
JOIN match m ON bim.match_id = m.match_id
ORDER BY bm.max_runs DESC
